cohort: The study included all IVF/ICSI cycles performed in a single center between 2012 and 2016, specifically those resulting in a live birth delivery after 24 weeks or cycles with no surplus embryos remaining.
finding: Age, AMH, AFC, and sub-classified cause of infertility were independently associated with the results of an IVF/ICSI treatment (achieving a live birth).
gest_age: Successful live births were defined as delivery after 24 weeks
